description: Put a Tail 2 to sleep (POST /camera/sdk/poweroff). Despite the endpoint name, the camera's own web UI uses this for sleep/hibernate rather than a hard power cut: this MOVES the camera (stowing the gimbal face-down at pitch ~84–89°), suspends the media/streaming daemon (NDI/SRT/RTSP and /camera/test/status stop while asleep), and keeps the HTTP/WS server online so obsbot_tail2_wake can resume it over the network. Polls the status push until power_on reads false (~3–6s). Hardware-verified 2026-11-03.
name: obsbot_tail2_sleep
